name: feature_register_all

ownership.argument: This is the shape a native feature must imitate: a 12-byte thunk passing a static descriptor to feature_register_feature, not an app object.

provenance.source: Calls 28 per-feature register thunks in sequence with the registry as argument and stops at the first failure; the wrapped 28th call is the astrolink-relevant pattern: each thunk is a 12-byte function that calls feature_register_feature 0xC862898(registry, &descriptor).

notes: This is the shape a native feature must imitate: a 12-byte thunk passing a static descriptor to feature_register_feature, not an app object.
